title: Bow Willow

steps.prompt: A simple wooden recurve bow of pale willow with green cord wrapping at the grip, strung, standing upright. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: TripoSR commit 107cefdc, stabilityai/TripoSR weights, torch 2.11.0+cu128, marching cubes via scikit-image

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 4000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 1024 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 1.30 m, origin at the centre of the base.
